findings.description: `nextSteps` appends the fixed sentence 'On the first commit of a ticket pull request this is expected: the number did not exist yet.' to every ticket whose single row is not `done (PR n)`, without any check of whether this is actually the first commit or whether the number is known. The check always receives the pull request number (`PR_NUMBER`) and runs on every push, so a later commit where the row was simply never updated also gets told the red is expected and the number was unknown.
findings.title: Red CI message claims the number was unknown when it was known
